description:
About Our Brand & Products

Last Call Society is a curated craft-cocktail and bar-experience membership program based in Orange County, California. We partner with standout bars and lounges to offer members signature $5 cocktails, exclusive perks, and limited-run collectibles that celebrate elevated drinking culture and real-world experiences.

What Makes Us Different

We focus on authentic, in-person hospitality experiences—not generic discounts. Our venues are hand-selected, and our program is built around community, storytelling, and quality. Starting in Orange County, we are expanding throughout California with plans to reach all major cities, creating long-term growth for the brand and our affiliates.

How Affiliates Can Earn

Affiliates earn 20% commission on all full-price sales across our website, tracked automatically through unique affiliate links. There are no earning caps. Please note that on-sale or discounted items are excluded from commission.

How to Promote Us

Promote Last Call Society through social media posts, reels, stories, blogs, email lists, or in-person recommendations. Affiliates receive access to marketing assets, logos, and ready-to-use promotional materials inside their affiliate dashboard.

Other Information

This program is ideal for creators, hospitality professionals, and community leaders who love craft cocktails and local bar culture. As we expand across California, affiliates can grow alongside the brand. Select partners may receive ambassador opportunities through separate communication.
payout_period: Affiliate commissions are paid out every 90 days to allow time for order verification, refunds, and chargebacks to process. Approved commissions are automatically issued at the end of each 90-day payout cycle.
